scope: Two existing impl201 sibling-field negative sources now admitted by actual inline field precision, plus nearest same-callback conflicts. This is an independent diagnostic replay against copied compiler artifacts, not a full root acceptance gate.

identity.construction: An external rustc --test harness copied the existing test helpers and appended reviewer tests. No Cargo target or production source was changed. Eight copied compiler rlibs were frozen and rehashed; dependency libraries were resolved from the existing target-main directory. The observed source head is recorded separately from these actual artifact identities.

execution.backends: Actual Clang and LLVM API, both O0/O2, two unchanged original sources. Reports confirm each backend and no fallback.

execution.purpose: Replay the exact two proposed permanent regression tests through existing baseline/raw_reject helpers; retain actual attacked Wire, fresh candidate and independent Verify diagnostics.

semantic_result: The mutable callback child and value mutation use disjoint actual fields of the same concrete Store element. Both kernels compute actual inline intervals while retaining the Store coarse root and parent loan; mere field names do not grant apart.

A lending callback result continues to depend on its actual callback environment and parent element. A write to the proven disjoint Copy value field neither recalls the callback nor invalidates that environment. The two unchanged programs execute with expected output T/empty and exit zero.
A second same-callback call while the mutable child or prior lending result is live still rejects at the source boundary (Expand E-GENERIC-ARGUMENT).

Both source-derived raw same-callback attacks are ACCEPTED by Analyze. Fresh independently recomputed candidates then reject in Verify and decoded-Wire Verify with E-BORROW-CONFLICT. No Analyze rejection is claimed.

The retained raw controls duplicate the actual callback-parent ReborrowAddress or CallClosureBorrowed with a fresh SSA result. They do not substitute a same-type different target or rely on a stale candidate fingerprint.

normative_location.former_sentence: 本片仍保守按相交Store前缀核窗口，两个动态索引或两个字段不自动获得并行apart权限。
normative_location.clarification_proposed: Store结构依赖仍按相交前缀保守保持；只有两核从同一实际元素、已核内联布局和具体字段路径独立证明区间不相交时，才可分离这些字段的访问窗口。此分离不缩短父Store结构依赖或真实父借用，不许可重入同一回调、破坏仍有lending结果的环境、移动/替换父壳或执行相交Store结构操作。不同动态索引、字段名、同型值和未知或符号捕获来源不自行构成apart证明。
normative_location.scope: Parent integrates the normative clarification before migrating the two unchanged source expectations. No weakened reserve/pop/recall or symbolic-capture safety assertions are authorized.
